subject: Onboarding: SSO cutover window & sandbox service-account strategy
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alex Peterson <alex@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2024 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: SSO cutover window & sandbox service-account strategy

Hi Alex —

Following our kickoff, I pulled together the access-controls items we should lock in before the production cutover. High level ask: can you confirm the target cutover window (proposed below) and whether your ops team is OK creating the sandbox service accounts we discussed?

Proposed production cutover window (preferred):
- 2024-05-02 02:00 - 04:00 UTC (two-hour maintenance window, overlap with Redwood on-call)

Preflight checklist (summary):
- SAML: we need your SP metadata endpoint and the Entity ID we should configure. If you want to host metadata, send the URL; otherwise we can host it and provide an ACS URL.
- SCIM: we'll provision groups and users once the attribute map is confirmed. Attached is sa_mapping.csv with the initial set of service-account mappings for sandbox and prod.
- IP allowlist: please confirm public egress ranges for your tenant and we will add Redwood ingestion and webhook IPs. Example Redwood ranges: 34.72.0.0/16, 104.155.0.0/16 (we'll provide final list in Drive).
- Service accounts: agree naming convention and least-privilege roles. For onboarding, we propose: nimble-sbx-redwood-sa (sandbox, write limited) and nimble-prod-redwood-sa (prod, read-only except webhook).
- Org policies: token rotation cadence (recommended 30 days for sandbox, 7 days for prod ephemeral keys), and SCIM deprovision policy (immediate).

Attachments: sa_mapping.csv (mapping of Redwood roles -> Nimble roles) — small stub attached.

Next steps / owners:
- Alex (Nimble): confirm cutover window and ops participants to invite (ops@nimblehealth.com).
- Monica (Redwood CS): schedule SCIM sync and provide staging endpoints by Apr 17.
- Grace (Redwood): finalize SAML endpoints and publish preflight checklist to Drive (link below).

If that window doesn't work, propose two alternatives and we'll prioritize. Thanks — aiming to minimize blast radius and keep a fast rollback path.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: sa_mapping.csv (CSV stub - columns: sa_name, environment, permissions, intended_use)

From: Alex Peterson <alex@nimblehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@nimblehealth.com
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2024 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: SSO cutover window & sandbox service-account strategy

Grace —

Thanks for the clear plan. The proposed May 2 window looks reasonable to our SRE lead, but ops would prefer starting at 01:00 UTC and keeping a hard end at 05:00 UTC (extra buffer for smoke tests). Can Redwood support that extended window?

A couple of clarifying Qs:
- For SAML, we will host the IdP. Please send the ACS and metadata endpoints you need from us. Our team needs the Service Provider (SP) metadata fields (ACS URL, Entity ID, x509 cert thumbprint).
- For service accounts, which of the mappings in sa_mapping.csv need write privileges? We are trying to minimize write-capable accounts.
- Staging endpoints: can you confirm the SCIM and webhook endpoints (staging) so we can run a quick provisioning test?

On Fri, Apr 12, 2024 at 09:15 AM Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com> wrote:
> Following our kickoff, I pulled together the access-controls items we should lock in before the production cutover...

I'll loop in ops and our security contact; ops@nimblehealth.com please advise availability for a 30-minute preflight on Apr 18 or 19.

—Alex
Alex Peterson
Product Ops Manager
NimbleHealth

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Peterson <alex@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2024 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: SSO cutover window & sandbox service-account strategy

Alex —

We can support the extended window (01:00-05:00 UTC) and will have an engineer on-call for the entire period. Confirmed items and details below:

1) SAML / Metadata
- ACS (staging): https://staging.redwood.com/saml/acs/nimblehealth
- ACS (prod): https://api.redwood.com/saml/acs/nimblehealth
- SP Entity ID: urn:redwood:sp:nimblehealth
- We will send the SP metadata (XML) to ops@nimblehealth.com; please return your IdP metadata URL and cert.

2) SCIM / Provisioning
- SCIM staging endpoint: https://staging.redwood.com/scim/v2/tenants/nimblehealth
- SCIM provisioning will run over HTTPS with Bearer token scoped to group provisioning only for sandbox. For prod we'll use a scoped token for user create/update/deactivate.
- Initial provisioning schedule: Apr 19 16:00 UTC — small batch (50 users) to validate mapping. Full provisioning in prod during cutover.

3) Service-account mapping (attached)
- Attached sa_mapping.csv includes suggested permissions. Short answer: only nimble-prod-redwood-sa needs webhook write; nimble-sbx-redwood-sa should be read + limited write to a staging workspace.
- Naming convention: nimble-{env}-redwood-{role}, e.g., nimble-sbx-redwood-ingest. Please confirm naming on your side so we can automate creation.

4) IP allowlist and firewall
- We'll publish a final list of Redwood egress IPs in Drive by Apr 17. For now, use the example ranges Grace included. If you run NAT from a fixed pool, we can whitelist that single /24 at cutover to reduce blast radius.

5) Org policies & rotation
- Production token rotation: short-lived tokens (7 days) + daily rotation for webhook secrets. Sandbox: 30-day rotation acceptable.

Attachments: redwood-sso-preflight-checklist.pdf (full checklist), sa_mapping.csv (csv previously attached by Grace).

Next steps (owners + target dates):
- Alex (Nimble): provide IdP metadata URL & ops contact confirmation by Apr 17.
- Monica (Redwood): publish final IP list and invite to Apr 19 provisioning test.
- Grace (Redwood): create the Doc (Drive link) with the runbook and rollback steps by Apr 17.

We'll include a short canary smoke test plan in the Drive doc. Let me know if you'd like a dry-run earlier.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood-sso-preflight-checklist.pdf (10-page checklist), sa_mapping.csv

From: Alex Peterson <alex@nimblehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@nimblehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2024 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: SSO cutover window & sandbox service-account strategy

Monica / Grace —

Thanks for the detail; this is helpful. Ops confirms Apr 19 provisioning test at 16:00 UTC and availability for the cutover window 01:00-05:00 UTC on May 2.

Couple requests before we lock schedule:
- Please add ops@nimblehealth.com to the SP metadata notification so our SRE gets the cert and ACS confirmation.
- For the smoke test during cutover, can Redwood run three quick checks: SCIM user create/update, webhook delivery to staging, and a token rotation validation? We can run the acceptance tests within the 01:00-02:00 UTC slot and then a broader smoke pass in 03:00-04:00 UTC.

On Mon, Apr 15, 2024 at 09:02 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> We can support the extended window (01:00-05:00 UTC) and will have an engineer on-call...

If that all looks good, we'll treat this as confirmed and update our change calendar. Please add any final notes to the Drive runbook link you published.

—Alex
Alex Peterson
Product Ops Manager
NimbleHealth

--
